name: Tivit, Seller of Secrets

abilities.text: Whenever ~ enters or deals combat damage to a player, starting with you, each player votes for evidence or bribery. For each evidence vote, investigate. For each bribery vote, create a Treasure token.
While voting, you may vote an additional time.

notes: Council's dilemma is `vote` with `resolve: 'per-vote'` (CR 701.38). The `extra-votes` static has no entry in the family's `render` map, so the round trip scores its line against the humanised kind name ("extra votes") — a renderer gap, not a defect of the script.
